title: 📢 Virginia Tech center marks 50 years boosting seafood jobs
text:
1 days ago 📢 50 years of Virginia Tech support for seafood industry
For 50 years , the Virginia Seafood Agricultural Research and Extension Center (AREC) in Hampton has been helping Virginia’s seafood industry stay strong and competitive.
Virginia’s seafood industry brings in over $1.27 billion a year and supports more than 6,500 jobs . The center connects Virginia Tech research with seafood businesses, working on food safety , aquaculture , invasive species, new technology, market development , economic analysis, and workforce training .
Recent investments in the center created an estimated $51.7 million in economic impact across Virginia over five years, supported 1,761 jobs , helped keep 396 businesses open, and helped create 14 new businesses . Its annual economic impact is estimated at $19 million–$33 million , supporting 500–800 jobs .
The center also runs a K–12 Workforce Development Program that has reached more than 14,000 students since 2024 , plus housing for up to six students at a time to do hands-on research in Hampton.
Current director Jonathan van Senten is leading seven programs as the center plans for its next 50 years.
